headings.instruction: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight). Import via Google Fonts.

body.instruction: Crucial for legibility of numeric data (INR, stock, ratings). Import via Google Fonts.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: You MUST use exactly these hex codes. Background must be #0f1216. All card/surface backgrounds must be #171c22. The primary accent for buttons, active states, and star ratings must be #ff7a2f.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 for all panels. Use sharp 1px borders to separate panels from the background.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-lg (8px) for cards, rounded-md for buttons/inputs.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive elements must have distinct hover states (e.g., hover:bg-white/5 or hover:brightness-110 for accent).
visual_enhancers.transparency: DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or sticky headers. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#171c22]/90.

layouts.general: Mobile-first. Use full-width stack on mobile, expanding to dense grids on desktop.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Protocol: High Density Grid (Mode B). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
layouts.panels: Generous padding inside panels (p-4 to p-6).
layouts.table: Deep dense table view for inventory on desktop. Allow horizontal scroll on mobile to keep data intact.

components.login_register: Clean centralized card on #0f1216 background. Inputs should have bg-[#0f1216] (recessed) and border-white/10.
components.profile_header: Showcase rating prominently (lucide-react Star icon, fill='#ff7a2f', text='#ff7a2f'). Display vendor name and location cleanly.
components.inventory_table: Editable row inputs must have distinct focus rings (focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#ff7a2f]). Explicitly show INR ₹ format (e.g. ₹ 450).
components.low_stock_flag: Highlight the low stock cell explicitly with text-[#ef4444] and a subtle red background (bg-[#ef4444]/10).
components.orders_list: Clean list view. Use pills/badges for order status.
components.avatar: Use Shadcn Avatar with initials (e.g. text-[#ff7a2f] bg-[#ff7a2f]/10).

motion.transitions: Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors duration-200). NEVER use transition-all.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in and slight slide-up (framer-motion) for dashboard panels.

image_urls.description: Images for generic placements if needed (e.g., empty states or placeholder thumbnails)

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='vendor-login-button').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure foreground text contrasts properly against #171c22 and #0f1216.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic placeholder services like via.placeholder.com. Use the provided image URLs.
Ensure the layout is highly responsive (mobile-first).
Do NOT use text-align: center globally in the App.
Use lucide-react for icons. Star ratings must use Lucide Star icons with fill active.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle 1px white/10 borders.
Add interactions to all buttons and inputs (focus, hover).
Render INR ₹ explicitly for all price data.
Do not build backend or business logic; rely entirely on the API.
